headword: {海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}

definitions.gloss: swimming beach; bathing beach; seaside bathing area
definitions.explanation: A designated area along the coast where people can swim in the sea, typically with facilities such as changing rooms, lifeguards, and beach houses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: In summer, the swimming beaches get crowded.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水質|すいしつ}→水質：22420_suishitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This beach is popular because of its good water quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{県内|けんない}→県内：27823_kennai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遊泳禁止|ゆうえいきんし}になった。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, all swimming beaches in the prefecture were closed to swimmers.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{海水浴|かいすいよく}→海水浴：10972_kaisuiyoku⟧ (sea bathing) + {場|じょう} (place, grounds). Refers to an officially designated coastal area for swimming, not just any stretch of beach. In Japan, {海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう} typically operate only during the summer season (roughly July through August) and are staffed with lifeguards during that period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}→開設：14595_kaisetsu⟧: opening of a swimming beach
- {海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉鎖|へいさ}→閉鎖：14524_heisa⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: a beach is closed
- {遊泳禁止|ゆうえいきんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{海水浴場|かいすいよくじょう}: a beach closed to swimmers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: coast, seashore — the physical coastline, not necessarily a swimming area
- ⟦ビーチ→ビーチ：10163_biichi⟧: beach — a loanword used more casually, often for resort-style beaches
- ⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：12333_sunahama⟧: sandy beach — describes the type of shore surface
